key_points: Multiple sources project GS to lead Wall Street with ~$19B Q3 trading revenue, boosting pre-earnings optimism
TIKR reports GS not raising 14-16% ROE target, a mild negative for long-term return expectations
Top executives slated for up to $500M in special equity awards, potential shareholder concern
Mixed institutional/insider flows: some buying (Artemis, Mn Services) but notable selling (Gradient, Central Pacific, Rep. Salazar)
Q3 earnings imminent (~Oct 13); current moves largely pre-positioning rather than thesis-changing
